steps.description:
Show that you can create a function named beepingSound and do the following:
1. Play a beeping sound of 5 beeps.

Show that your robot can call your function beepingSound

Show that you can create a function named beepingSound with 1 argument named loop and do the following:
1. Use the argument named loop to control the number of beeps with an interval of 1 second

Show that your robot can call your function beepingSound with an argument of 5

Show that you can create a function named beepingSound with 1 argument named loop and do the following:
1. Use the argument named loop to control the number of beeps with an interval of 1 second

Show that your robot can call your function beepingSound with an argument of 5

Show that you can create a function named beepingSound with 1 argument named loop and do the following:
1. Use the argument named loop to control the number of beeps with an interval of 1 second

Show that your robot can call your function beepingSound with an argument of 10

Show that you can create a function named beepingSound with 1 argument named loop and do the following:
1. Use the argument named loop to control the number of beeps with an interval of 1 second

Show that your robot can call your function beepingSound with an argument of 5

Show that you can create a function named beepingSound with 1 argument named loop and do the following:
1. Use the argument named loop to control the number of beeps with an interval of 1 second

Show that your robot can call your function beepingSound with an argument of 10
